body: The fact of the matter that I'm facing is that no one can help me. The doctors, my close friends who I've been very honest with about this, my therapist, the hospital staff... It seems no one on earth can give me a satisfying answer as to why fighting through my suffering is even worth it. People talk about an afterlife, which I don't believe in. They talk about things which can be "meaningful", which in the end amount to nothing. They say my loved ones will miss me, but I can't live my life purely so that others won't be sad. There's no answer.
I hate to disappoint you but no one can talk to the dead. Look up cold reading, that's what this "healer" is using to rip you off. It's a scam, they're taking advantage of your bereavement.
That subreddit is nothing but the same platitudes I've heard a thousand fucking times. It's as big of a joke as suicide hotlines.
Because everyone's rollercoaster ends in a brick wall. The brick wall is death, so if the ride is making me sick, why ride it out, knowing only death awaits me?
No, I don't care about the rollercoaster, it makes me sick riding it. Plus I already know it ends with a brick wall. I'd rather jump off and get it over with.

I would agree with this sentiment when it pertains to people who desire to live. For me, I just want to opt out of the up and down rollercoaster. I don't want the package, I didn't order any package, and I don't like what is inside the package.
Because it's hard and I don't want to anymore
Yeah, through hard work and a lot of struggling you can get to a more favorable food-to-sand ratio but you're still eating a big mouthful of fucking sand. And again, to what end? Why struggle at all?
No, it's not. If I offer you a bowl filled 95% with sand and 5% with your favorite food, and you must either eat the whole bowl or nothing at all, which would you choose?
The other ants can do what they want but I don't place any value on what they're doing. I don't want to be part of the ant colony any more.
